items.quote: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
items.claim: When Joshua heard the people shouting, he told Moses there was a noise of war in the camp.
items.action: heard the people shouting and told Moses it sounded like war
items.object: the noise of the people shouting
items.mechanism: Joshua took the sound of shouting to mean there was fighting and told Moses so
